summary: Lower awaited fs/promises writeFile only with Promise scheduling plus Node write flags, encodings, and best-effort abort semantics.

requirements.usage: directly awaited or otherwise lowered through JS-compatible Promise machinery

semantics.abort_signal: best effort; some data may already have been written when rejection occurs
semantics.concurrency: overlapping writeFile calls to same file without awaiting are unsafe

caveats: Cancellation must not be modeled as transactional rollback.
Iterable/AsyncIterable data requires JS iteration semantics and may need broader runtime support.
Task continuation ordering must be adapted to JS Promise microtasks.

tests.name: await write fulfills undefined
tests.expected_behavior: fulfills with JS undefined after the write completes

tests.name: abort is best effort
tests.input: const c=new AbortController(); const p=fsp.writeFile('a',big,{signal:c.signal}); c.abort(); await p;
tests.expected_behavior: may reject with AbortError after some bytes were already written; helper must not promise rollback
